text:
adrian-cust: Hey team, presales ask: we need BYOK via our CloudHSM, KEK rotation every 4 hours, and immutable per-key audit lines for our SOC2 audit. Our matching service needs ~15ms p50 token latency. Can Redwood validate in a short POC and show cost impact?
zoe-sales: yes — we recommend a 3-week POC to prove latency, unwrap ops, and provide attestation artifacts. We'll include a cost projection for key ops.
sam-se: two modes to validate in POC:
- sidecar key-proxy: keeps unwrapped KEK in-memory for a short TTL (best for latency, needs mem-lock + attestation)
- strict KMS unwrap per session: highest security posture, likely higher p50

sam-se: sample sidecar knobs for the perf run:
```yaml
sidecar:
  cache_ttl: 60s  # unwrapped KEK lifetime in RAM
  max_cached_keys: 8
  mem_lock: true
rotation:
  cron: "0 */4 * * *"  # 4-hour cadence
```
mira-security: auditors will need: HSM attestation PDF (vendor cert chain), signed proof-of-possession for CMEK, and per-op logging (event, key_id, ts, principal, request_id). We can produce a canonical log schema.
adrian-cust: can you paste a sample single-line audit event we can ingest into our SIEM?
sam-se: sample single-line JSON (we'll provide full schema in SOW):
```
{"ts":"2026-02-18T15:03:22Z","event":"unwrap","key_id":"custA/prod/kek-2026-02","request_id":"r_aa43","principal":"svc/matcher","src_ip":"10.0.9.12"}
```
zoe-sales: POC plan (3 weeks):
- Week 0: kickoff, exchange FW rules, attestation requirements, SIEM ingest sample
- Week 1: deploy sidecar to staging + baseline perf (p50/p95)
- Week 2: rotation stress (rotate every 4h for 72h), collect unwrap ops, error rates, and cost delta
- Week 3: deliver attestations, logs, and go/no-go review with auditors

zoe-sales: pricing note: HSM unwraps and egress may be billed per-op; we'll include an itemized projection in the SOW. Dedicated capacity can be used to smooth unit costs if preferred.
adrian-cust: we peak at ~220 reqs/s, target p50 ~15ms. If sidecar with cache_ttl=60s meets SLA and logs look good, we can sign SOW.
sam-se: perf approach: I'll push a harness that toggles cache_ttl (15s/60s/300s) and simulates varying principal cardinality to show unwrap/sec vs p50. We'll also run rotation jitter tests.
mira-security: I'll attach a sample attestation filename and contents in the SOW addendum (example: cloudhsm_attest_custA_20260218.pdf with cert chain and firmware info). Also will include a signed manifest of keys for proof-of-possession tests.
ops-bot: deploy-status: key-proxy v1.1 rolled to stg-4 at 2026-02-18T15:10:01Z :rocket:
zoe-sales: action items: @sam-se to draft perf plan & SOW, @mira-security to add attest/log schema, @adrian-cust to confirm any FIPS requirement and final QPS envelope.
adrian-cust: thanks — we'll confirm FIPS by EOD and look forward to perf numbers. :thumbsup:
